_comment: Reviewed calibration corpus for the universal automatic gate engine (spec sections 8.2 and 8.4).
Versioned, and read once from the jar rather than through the datapack reload: it is a built-in
profile, and a pack that disagrees writes an ordinary lock rule or a data/<ns>/runicskills/gates
rule, both of which outrank everything this file produces.
Three kinds of row, and the difference matters:
runic_builtin_default  - a requirement this mod has shipped as a reviewed built-in default.
irons_book_profile     - a reviewed Iron's spellbook gate, carried over from
data/runicskills/irons/book_profiles.json. Intelligence is the shared
0.6 ratio that provider applies, stated here so the anchor is complete.
explicit_ungated       - content that deliberately requires nothing. These are NOT filler: they
are what stops a wooden sword inheriting a golden sword's requirement
because the cheapest gated anchor was the nearest one available.
NOTHING here may come from the engine's own output. CalibrationCorpus.isEngineSource refuses any
row whose source is an inference provenance string, so an exported catalog cannot be pasted back
in and become its own training data. That is the defect that produced the old keyword book table,
one generation removed.
The harvest_block anchors exist only for autoGateHarvestBlocks, which is OFF by default. They are
not new balance: each gated row is the Building level of the cheapest vanilla pickaxe that can
drop the block, which this mod has shipped as a reviewed built-in default since the lock table
existed. The stone tier is ungated for the same reason its pickaxe is.
Levels are at the reference per-skill cap of 32 with multiplier 1. Feature ranges are FIXED: they
are not recomputed from whatever is installed, so one unusually strong modded item cannot
renormalise a server's balance.

10 slots, fire spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana. A full school package; obtained from a 1% blaze drop, which is early for the power it carries but is a drop rate rather than a progression step.
5 slots, no attribute modifiers, crafted from copper ingots + string + paper. The entry-level chassis and the anchor the other rows are ranked against.
10 slots and +100 max mana, crafted from diamond + enchanted book + magic cloth + hogskin. Drops gold's cast-time penalty and adds two slots: a verified upgrade, so a clear step up.

12 slots, ender spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana, crafted from six dragonskin + obsidian + a ruined book. Byte-for-byte the ice spellbook's chassis and stat package with a different school, so it is ranked EQUAL to ice rather than above it. The proposed 26 treated a verified sidegrade as an upgrade; shipping it as a metadata profile instead would have split one sidegrade pair across two layers and produced two different numbers for the same item.
10 slots, nature spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana: the same chassis as blaze with a different school, so deliberately the same requirement rather than an invented ranking between two sidegrades.
8 slots, +50 max mana and +15% cast time, crafted from arcane essence + hogskin. First book with attributes, and the cast-time cost is why it does not outrank diamond.
12 slots, ice spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana, crafted from mithril scrap + three ice venom vials + a ruined book. The most demanding acquisition chain of the verified books.
6 slots, no attribute modifiers, crafted from chains + leather + paper. One clear step above copper on capacity alone.
12 slots, +20% cooldown reduction and +200 max mana, crafted from netherite + ruined book + blood vial + lightning bottle. Late-game acquisition and a general-purpose benefit rather than one school.
10 slots, holy spell power +0.1, cast time +0.1 and +200 max mana. Three modifiers on a diamond-sized chassis, acquired by priest trade.
